images.title: Add the numbers in the picture
images.purpose: Show a picture of numbers whose total can be added in several ways and always simplifies to the same expression.
images.composition: One 4 by 4 block of cells in the centre with a prompt line beneath; wide white space.
exact_structure: A 4 by 4 block of equal square cells outlined in #2B2B2B, 16 cells in all.
Top row: 4 cells each containing "3", filled light teal #0072B2. Bottom row: 4 cells each containing "3", filled light teal #0072B2. That is 8 threes in total.

The two middle rows: in each, the second cell from the left contains "r" (filled light amber #E69F00) and the third cell contains "s" (filled light reddish purple #CC79A7); the first and fourth cells of each middle row are empty white cells with a thin grey #6B7280 outline. That gives 2 r and 2 s in all.
Below the block, centred, one line "Total = ?" with the question mark in reddish purple #CC79A7.
No answer expression and no brackets in the image.
rejection: a count of 3s other than 8, of r other than 2, or of s other than 2
r or s appearing in the top or bottom row
images.takeaway: The same picture can be added row by row, by like terms or by doubling a half, with one result.
images.description: A grid with a row of four 3s on top, two middle rows each holding r and s, and a row of four 3s below.
images.context: Shown beside the picture example text.
images.teaching_notes: Count the 3s, the r and the s first, then choose a way to add them.

image_decisions.why: The grid makes the like terms, eight 3s, two r and two s, visible at a glance.
